== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Eledari [[Pact]] is a fundamental cosmic agreement that restricts the ability of [[Abidan]] members to interfere with the destiny and Fate{{!}}fate of healthy [[Iterations]]. This pact serves as a barrier that prevents powerful entities from altering the natural course of events or intervening to prevent disasters within these worlds. While most [[Abidan]] agents are bound by these rules, certain specialized roles, such as [[Executors]], are designed to operate without being subject to the pact's limitations. Violating these terms can lead to serious consequences, including formal accusations of dereliction of duty.}}
